ImageDescription.value: The summit of Errigal consists of two peaks connected by a short but precarious ridge. This is the view from the lower peak back towards the summit proper - the higher peak at 751m. Nearing the summit the cloud descended to about 700m but it should be visible through the mist - 1052814 is a similar view but in clearer conditions. Note that the OSi map still claims that a trig point marks the summit - this has long since disappeared, probably blasted by lightning and eroded into the scree on the lower slopes.
